data.summary: This week, Ethan Qiu had 27 GitHub contributions across five public repositories, led by UTMIST/Misty with 16 contributions. He also contributed to qiuethan/now, UTMIST/UTMIST, qiuethan/Portfolio, and qiuethan/qiuethan, and opened pull requests in UTMIST/Misty#246 and UTMIST/UTMIST#472, #473, and #481. He reviewed pull requests in UTMIST/Misty#206, #221, #228–#248, and UTMIST/UTMIST#456 and #464.
